purpose: Args.add_all/add_joined `map_each` (starlarkbuildapi/CommandLineArgsApi.java:213-218, 392-397: a StarlarkCallable or None, checked when the call binds; Args.validateMapEach, analysis/starlark/Args.java:366-388: only a StarlarkFunction must be global): any callable, a built-in such as `json.encode` or `str` included; a non-callable is `in call to add_all(), parameter 'map_each' got value of type 'int', want 'callable or NoneType'` (also add_joined), before addVectorArg's format-string checks. Motivation: after unresolved symlinks, `build --nobuild //src/ts/...` on ~/code stopped at `analysis of //src/ts/bport:layers: ... @@aspect_rules_js+//js/private:js_image_layer.bzl:515, in _js_image_layer_impl  entries.add_joined(  error: map_each must be a function or None` (`map_each = json.encode`, js/private/js_image_layer.bzl:510-545).

reference.environment: env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin HOME/TMPDIR private LANG=C.UTF-8 LC_ALL=C.UTF-8; one fresh copy of the fixture workspace per case (the genuine platforms 1.0.0 module extracted into `platforms` from tests/fixtures/label_repo_name/platforms_archive.json)

normalization: <WS> = the case's workspace copy; <OB> = the genuine output base; <CACHE> = the native cache; elapsed times <T>. Outputs are the top-level outputs (genuine --show_result lines, bazel-bin = bazel-out/k8-fastbuild/bin; native LABEL<TAB>PATH lines below the action output root) as [mode, contents].
comparison (tests/args_map_each.rs, live: MATCH: success equal; WARNING lines equal in order; a failing case's genuine message (or the recorded part of it) (the `Error in <callable>: ` / `Error: ` Starlark text, else the rule error following an empty `in KIND rule L: ` line, else the first ERROR message) is contained in native stderr; built top-level outputs (path below bazel-out -> [mode, contents]) equal; a `test` case's stdout (the test summary, ` in N.Ns` run times as ` in <T>s`) equal; a successful `run` case's stdout (the program's output) equal; a `query` case's stdout equal; the recorded outputs' existence after the command equal. DECLARED_DIVERGENCE: native fails with the recorded message.
genuine_key_findings: js_image_layer's entries: `add_joined([path, {...}], join_with = ":", map_each = json.encode)` is `"bin/app":{"dest":"app.sh","root":"bazel-out/k8-fastbuild/bin"}` (dict keys sorted) in a multiline parameter file; add_all with json.encode over strings, lists and dicts (`["y",1]`, `{"a":null,"k":true}`) with before_each; `str` over ints and bools (`1`, `True`); json.encode over a depset with format_each (`<"p">`), with add_joined's format_joined (`["u"+"v"]`) and uniquify; an empty vector with omit_if_empty = False adds nothing.

A non-callable map_each (int, string) is the binding error `in call to add_joined(), parameter 'map_each' got value of type 'int', want 'callable or NoneType'` / `in call to add_all(), parameter 'map_each' got value of type 'string', want 'callable or NoneType'`, also before an invalid format_each.
known_divergences: Native prints its own result format (`LABEL\tPATH`, `bazel-rs: N actions executed ...`), no INFO lines.
Native is passed --experimental-builtin-modules in every case (as in the other paired fixtures).
